title: Onboard zenith-13b-v1.0: performance profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Priya Desai
description: This PR adds the zenith-13b-v1.0 model to the model registry with metadata, performance profiles across supported instance types, and automated changelog/release notes generation for new model onboarding. Motivation: zenith-13b is a community-released model with good quality/cost tradeoffs; adding it to the registry enables developers to try it in Redwood with precomputed performance expectations and automated release notes to keep the catalog consistent. Changes include: 1) model metadata (manifest + tags + sha checksums), 2) perf profiles for GPU families (A100, H100, V100 equivalents) at typical seq lengths and batch sizes, 3) quantization compatibility flags and recommended quant configs, 4) an entrypoint in the registry index, and 5) automation hooks to append a templated release note to CHANGELOG.md when the model metadata passes CI. The PR includes a small verification harness used by CI that runs smoke inference on a pinned prompt to validate output shape and basic stability. See commits for a high-level breakdown. Checklist: - [x] Add model manifest and assets references - [x] Add perf profile JSON for supported instance types - [x] Add quantization recommendation metadata - [x] Add changelog automation template and GH Action step - [x] Add smoke harness and CI job - [x] Add unit tests for manifest schema validation - [x] Documentation: updated registry README with zenith-13b notes
